comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body: Found in North Hobart in the center of the map, just slightly southwest of the ruins landmark. Appears in the middle of the night in clear conditions, meaning no clouds/rain can be present.

comments.author: V_I
comments.body:
You do need R2 Recognition or greater. Also, you can actually discover it right by the landing point exit/entrance which leads to Hobart! There's no need to go walking much at all.

GVDB Entry: gvdb.mydns.jp/db/module/QuestDB/action/QuestShow?id=5596

I think I did that right?
